capabilities: scan the vault for duplicate files, unused attachments, empty and orphan notes, and large files
generate a report of cleanup opportunities by issue category
review and select detected items before any action
move selected files to system trash or permanently delete them with extra confirmation
exclude selected items or protected folders from future scans
extras: Never deletes automatically; all processing is local with no network requests, account, analytics, or telemetry. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to find and clean up clutter such as duplicate files, orphan notes, or attachments no longer referenced by any note.
summary: Vault maintenance tool that scans the vault for duplicate files, unused attachments, empty and orphan notes, and large files, with review-first cleanup.
